F11.1.title: declared on a dimension, data from the fact
F11.1.solution: Anchor = the table the physical columns come from (after inlining measures), never the DAX home table. Apply in translation AND at DDL emission.

F11.2.solution: Inline the referenced measures first, then anchor on the one table all columns come from.

F11.3.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN product.CATEGORY = 'Hardware' THEN orders."QTY" ELSE 0 END)
F11.3.title: measure table + filter on a related dimension
F11.3.solution: Anchor on the fact (Orders): it reaches Product through a many-to-one relationship, so the dimension filter is valid there (join or enriched copy).

F12.1.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN product.PRODUCTID = 2 THEN orders."AMOUNT" ELSE 0 END)
F12.1.title: filter on the dimension KEY -> fact foreign key
F12.1.solution: If the filtered column is the 'to' key of a relationship fact->dim, rewrite the condition onto the fact's 'from' column (same table, no join).

F12.2.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN product.CATEGORY = 'Software' THEN orders."AMOUNT" ELSE 0 END)
F12.2.title: filter on a dimension ATTRIBUTE
F12.2.solution: Non-key attribute of a related dimension (reachable many-to-one): use the enriched copy <DIM>_<COLUMN> on the fact, or the dimension column through the relationship. Unreachable -> NULL + reason.

F12.3.sql: CASE WHEN ((AVG(CASE WHEN product."PRODUCTID" = 1 THEN orders."PRICE" END::FLOAT) IS NOT NULL)) AND ((AVG(CASE WHEN product."PRODUCTID" = 3 THEN orders."PRICE" END::FLOAT) IS NOT NULL)) THEN AVG(CASE WHEN product."PRODUCTID" = 1 THEN orders."PRICE" END::FLOAT) - AVG(CASE WHEN product."PRODUCTID" = 3 THEN orders."PRICE" END::FLOAT) ELSE NULL END
F12.3.title: two fixed-key filters subtracted with ISBLANK guards
F12.3.solution: Same key rewrite inside each CALCULATE; NOT ISBLANK(x) -> x IS NOT NULL; IF without else -> NULL.

F12.4.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN calendar.MONTH_NO = 3 THEN orders."AMOUNT" ELSE 0 END)
F12.4.title: filter on a date-dimension attribute (active relationship)
F12.4.solution: Date dimension attribute through the ACTIVE relationship (Order Date): enriched copy or join.

F13.1.title: USERELATIONSHIP on the inactive date path
F13.1.solution: Emit each inactive relationship as an alias of the dimension named '<Dim> <FK column>' (here calendar_ship_date) joined on that FK; USERELATIONSHIP(...) switches the filter to that alias.

F13.2.title: USERELATIONSHIP with a row count
F13.2.solution: Same alias rule; counts use COUNT(CASE WHEN ... THEN key END) with no ELSE.

F13.3.title: without USERELATIONSHIP the ACTIVE path is used
F13.3.solution: The alias must not change measures that do not ask for it.
